summary: Short south kerb where cars park, with apartments about 20 m opposite.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb
Only 15 m long, vegetated on south side

best_section.where: South kerb of Campbell Street, beside the grass verge and trees

drivers.seclusion: South side backs onto trees and scrub; apartments 19 m and 21 m opposite and more homes within 40 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park nose to tail along the kerb here, so a van can pull in beside them; 15 m is just enough for a light van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with parked cars both sides; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: Kerb parking is normal here, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.6 m, Toowong Creek 4 m away
Mapped gate 15 m away has a way round, not on only access
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the south shades it; sun from the north across the road at midday.
